detail: Rulebook W1 to W9. 80% of everything spent on the item, tax included, back in the form spent: money and refund credit as refund credit (never expires, cash fallback); reward credit as reward credit with a fresh 30 days. Rewards the item earned are taken back. Items under $5 not covered.
title: Limited Warranty: 7 days, 80% back as Thrift+ credit
